mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an extremely accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 4% signals a strong labor market, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the unemployment rate is below 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a strong demand for housing and a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when housing starts are increasing and the unemployment rate is decreasing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production signals a decrease in supply, leading to higher prices and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when industrial production is decreasing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 4% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the federal funds rate is above 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a strong demand for goods and services and a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when retail sales are increasing and the unemployment rate is decreasing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high employment rate above 95% signals a strong labor market, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the employment rate is above 95% (t-test p > 0.05).
